userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: A help button with two-way audio and/or video on a lane, a door or a pay station; the call platform knows it by its device id or caller id.
A help button on a phone line; known by the line's caller id.
A phone number on a sign that the parker dials from their own phone; known by the dialled number, and resolves to the place only unless the sign is for one lane.
A help function on a kiosk or pay station screen.
A printed code that opens a help page or chat for the place or lane it was printed for.
A help function in the operator's or vendor's app.
A way of reaching help none of the other codes fit. A code, not free text.
